plusgactionsource.remarks: The source of the action, for example, UK HSE.

plusgpolicynum.title: Operating Policy
plusgpolicynum.remarks: The operating policy that is associated with this record. The operating policy must be in Active status. When you duplicate a record, the operating policy identifier is copied to the duplicated record.

plusgdefmeaspt.title: Measurement Point
plusgdefmeaspt.remarks: Measurement point that can be used to measure the defect rate.

plusgmocdeferralid.title: MOC or Deferral ID
plusgmocdeferralid.remarks: A reference for the originating management of change request or deferral.

plusgdegfact.title: Degradation Factor
plusgdegfact.remarks: The factor by which the equipment has degraded.

bulletinboardid.title: Message ID
bulletinboardid.remarks: The identifier of the bulletin board message.

plusassrev.title: Asset Revision
plusassrev.remarks: The revision of the asset at the time of its association with the current work order.

plusgpermitworkid.title: Permit to Work Identifier
plusgpermitworkid.remarks: The unique identifier of the permit to work.

plusgreviewby.title: Review By
plusgreviewby.remarks: The person who created the pre-start safety review.

pmex_is_maintenance.title: Prescriptive Maintenance on Cloud event is for maintenance?
pmex_is_maintenance.remarks: Prescriptive Maintenance on Cloud is the event for maintenance?

plusgccf.title: Common Cause Failure
plusgccf.remarks: When selected, indicates that the failure has a common cause.

plusdprereqtype.title: Prerequisite Type
plusdprereqtype.remarks: Identifies the type of prerequisite that is needed.

plusgteamleadid.title: Team Leader
plusgteamleadid.remarks: The team leader of the improvement project

plusdestapproh.title: Overhead
plusdestapproh.remarks: Estimate at Approval - Estimated overhead cost from Compatible Unit Estimating application at the time of work order approval.  This field is updated by the Work Order Approval Process.

plusgdefectref.title: Related Defect
plusgdefectref.remarks: The reference number for the defect

plusgdrivetype.title: Drive Type
plusgdrivetype.remarks: The type of drive that is used on the drilling rig. Valid values are in the PLUSGDRIVETYPE domain.

plusgstagegate.title: Project Stage Gate
plusgstagegate.remarks: The project stage gate that is associated with the work order. Valid values are in the PLUSGSTAGEGATE domain. You can change this value until the work order is canceled or closed.

plusmrule.title: Maintenance Rule
plusmrule.remarks: Indicates whether this component is critical to the successful operation of the plant and therefore subject to a regulatory maintenance rule. A maintenance rule typically states that when the performance or condition of a component does not meet established goals, appropriate corrective action must be taken.

plusganalysismeth.title: Analysis Method
plusganalysismeth.remarks: The method of analysis used for the improvement project

plusgtechauthority.title: Technical Authority
plusgtechauthority.remarks: The person who is the technical authority for the test. The person must be designated a technical authority in the People application.

plusgtemp.title: Temporary
plusgtemp.remarks: Identifies that the change is temporary.

plusgdefuntildate.title: Deferral Until
plusgdefuntildate.remarks: The date that the work deferred by the management of change can be deferred until.

plusgpolicyid.title: Operating Policy
plusgpolicyid.remarks: The operating procedure that is associated with this record.

plusgrequireddate.title: Required Date
plusgrequireddate.remarks: The date the management of change is required.

plusghardfailmode.title: Hardware Failure Mode
plusghardfailmode.remarks: The hardware failure mode in accordance with International Electrotechnical Commission (IEC) standard 61508.

plusgevidence.title: Evidence
plusgevidence.remarks: The reasons that support the decision to include the preparation activities in a package of work.

plusgsubcode.title: Subunit/Component Code
plusgsubcode.remarks: The identifier of the subunit or the component that failed.

plusgfailimpactonfunction.title: Impact of Failure on Function
plusgfailimpactonfunction.remarks: The impact of the failure on the functioning of the equipment.

plusgfunction.title: Function
plusgfunction.remarks: The function that is responsible for the reason for work that is associated with the work order. Valid values are in the PLUSGFUNCTION domain.

plusdagency.title: Agency
plusdagency.remarks: The regulatory organization that requires the prerequisite to be completed.

plusgsafecrielem.title: Safety-Critical Element
plusgsafecrielem.remarks: A reference to any element that is critical to safety and that is associated with a regulation. A performance standard that regulates the emission of hazardous substances can be a type of safety-critical reference.

plusalcexception.title: Exception
plusalcexception.remarks: This check box indicates that the condition does not satisfy the acceptance criteria.

plusgclosurecomm.title: Closure Comments
plusgclosurecomm.remarks: Comments about the closure of the management of change.

splanreviewdate.title: Has safetyplan review date?
splanreviewdate.remarks: Does this Work Order safetplan is reviwed?

plusclearreq.title: Clearance Protection Required
plusclearreq.remarks: Indicates whether the work order requires clearance protection. The association with a work order is defined in the clearance record. Depending on the settings that are defined for the clearance site, you can associate one or more clearances with a single work order.

plusgra.title: Generation Risk Assessment
plusgra.remarks: The location impact on power generation.

plusgmatrixprior.title: Matrix Priority
plusgmatrixprior.remarks: Identifier of the matrix priority. Valid values are in the PLUSGMATRIXPRIOR domain.

plusgtempuntildate.title: Temporary Until
plusgtempuntildate.remarks: The date that the work deferred by the management of change can be deferred until.

plusgpermitrefno.title: Permit Reference
plusgpermitrefno.remarks: Number of the permit or certificate associated with the corresponding work order. This field can be editable or read-only, depending on the setting in the Control of Work Options in the Organizations application.

plusgsafmtgenteredbyname.title: Name
plusgsafmtgenteredbyname.remarks: The person who entered the details about the safety meeting. The status of the person record in the People application must be active.

plusgisolationnum.title: Isolation Certificate
plusgisolationnum.remarks: The isolation certificate record that is associated with the bypass management record.

plusgelevationcode.title: Casing Type
plusgelevationcode.remarks: The type of casing. Valid values are in the PLUSGCASINGTYPE domain.

plusgbypvalidity.title: Review Frequency
plusgbypvalidity.remarks: The interval of time, in days or hours, after which the bypass operation must be reviewed.

wonum.title: Work Order
wonum.remarks: The number you use to track actions taken to satisfy agreement requirements. The agreement is identified in the Reference field.

pluscondtag.title: Condition Tag
pluscondtag.remarks: Identifies a tag that has been placed in the field to flag a condition, deficiency, or work that is currently in progress.

pmex_asset_id.title: Prescriptive Maintenance on Cloud Asset Id
pmex_asset_id.remarks: Prescriptive Maintenance on Cloud Asset Id

plusplsystem.title: Plant System
plusplsystem.remarks: The plant system in which the specified component is located.

plusgscenario.title: Scenario
plusgscenario.remarks: The scenario that is associated with the preparation activities.

pmex_is_fail.title: Prescriptive Maintenance on Cloud event is for a failure?
pmex_is_fail.remarks: Prescriptive Maintenance on Cloud is the event because of an asset failure?

pluslocrev.title: Location Revision
pluslocrev.remarks: The revision of the location at the time of its association with the current work order.

plusgcontinplan.title: Contingency Plan
plusgcontinplan.remarks: Indicates whether the work order requires a contingency plan. If the check box is selected, the work order requires a contingency plan.

plusgfieldref.title: Field Reference
plusgfieldref.remarks: The field where drilling is occurring.

totalworkunits.title: Total Work Units
totalworkunits.remarks: Total Work Units for WO, including header asset and assets in MultiAssetLocCI table

plusgassactivity.title: Assurance Activity
plusgassactivity.remarks: Specifies whether the work order implements an assurance activity. If this check box is selected, an assurance activity is implemented.

plusgactexternal.title: External
plusgactexternal.remarks: Indicates that the action is in response to an external body

djperror.title: Calculation error
djperror.remarks: The error message when trying to apply the dynamic job plan

plusgprepref.title: Reference
plusgprepref.remarks: The reference to the work package that is associated with the preparation activities. If you use a project management system, you can reference the task identifier.

plus325deaddate.title: 3.25 Date
plus325deaddate.remarks: Identifies the 3.25 date, which is used to ensure conservative use of the grace period. This date is determined by adding 3.25 times the regulatory frequency to the dates of the performance that occurred two instances before.

plusgprepactiv.title: Preparation Activity
plusgprepactiv.remarks: Indicates whether the work order is associated with preparation activities

plusgtag.title: Tag
plusgtag.remarks: The tag that is associated with the bypass operation.

plusestregduedate.title: Estimated Regulatory Date
plusestregduedate.remarks: An estimate of the regulatory date for completion of a PM work order, that is based on the best available date information in the preceding PM work order. Actual dates are used where possible, followed by scheduled and target dates, in that order. The requirement for estimated regulatory dates must be specified in the associated PM record. If the requirement is set, an estimated regulatory date is calculated during work order generation for work orders that have a preceding work order, but do not have an actual regulatory date.

plusgtgtdatemod.title: Target Dates Overridden
plusgtgtdatemod.remarks: Indicates whether the target start or finish date for this work order was overridden and the new value exceeded the parameter set in the Organizations application. If the check box is selected, the target start or finish date was overridden and the new value exceeded the parameter.

plusestdeaddate.title: Estimated Dead Date
plusestdeaddate.remarks: An estimate of the final date for completion of a PM work order, based on the best available date information in the preceding PM work order. Actual dates are used where possible, followed by scheduled and target dates, in that order. The requirement for estimated regulatory dates must be specified in the associated PM record. If the requirement is set, an estimated dead date is calculated during work order generation for work orders that have a preceding work order, but do not have an actual dead date.

plusunit.title: Unit
plusunit.remarks: The unit in which the specified component is located.

plusgprepardnes.title: Preparedness
plusgprepardnes.remarks: An assessment of the readiness of the preparation activities.

plusgshiftlognum.title: Shift Log
plusgshiftlognum.remarks: The shift log that is associated with this work order.

isquickreported.title: Quick Reported Work Order
isquickreported.remarks: Indicates if this work order was created through quick reporting.

plusgpass.title: Pass
plusgpass.remarks: Indicates whether the test result passed the acceptance criteria.

plusgdecision.title: Decision
plusgdecision.remarks: The decision that is associated with including the preparation activities in a package of work.

plusgperfauth.title: Performing Authority
plusgperfauth.remarks: The performing authority for the permit or certificate type associated with the corresponding work order. Depending on the setting in the Control of Work Options in the Organizations application, the performing authority might need to be authorized in the People application.

plusgcustref.title: Customer Reference
plusgcustref.remarks: The reference that is used to identify the customer.

plusgderricktype.title: Derrick Type
plusgderricktype.remarks: The type of derrick that is used on the drilling rig. Valid values are in the PLUSGDERRICKTYPE domain.

plusgopenomuid.title: Open Unique Idenfitier
plusgopenomuid.remarks: The open unique identifier provided to Maximo by an external system.

worktype.title: Work Type
worktype.remarks: Identifies the work order's type. Some example types are: preventive maintenance, corrective maintenance, emergency maintenace, capital project, and event report.

plusimpctrqd.title: Impact Required
plusimpctrqd.remarks: Indicates a Impact is required for the Work Order

plusgfailsubdivrem.title: Failure Mechanism Subdivision Remarks
plusgfailsubdivrem.remarks: The description of the failure mechanism subdivision.

plusgopercondatfailure.title: Operating Condition during Failure
plusgopercondatfailure.remarks: The state of the equipment at the time of the failure.

plusgsafetycrit.title: Safety Critical
plusgsafetycrit.remarks: Indicates whether this location is a safety critical area. If the check box is selected, this location is a safety critical area.
